text:
ITEM 1 | Large piece of pale cream-to-golden meat with fibrous, shredded texture and a glossy, moist sheen, partly torn edges, draped over the upper center of the plate with a thin rim of tan juices; footprint roughly 25% of the plate, thickness about 2-3 cm | 180
ITEM 2 | Small brown lentil-like pulses scattered over and around the meat, matte and firm, dark tan with slight wrinkles, about 0.5 cm each, roughly 15-20 visible pieces | 12
ITEM 3 | Small fragment of pale cream meat or fat sliver lying at the left edge of the meat piece, flattened, about 3 cm long | 8
ITEM 4 | Mound of white cooked grains, moist and slightly clumped, soft with separate grains visible, sitting at the lower left of the plate, about 7 x 6 cm footprint and 2 cm high | 110
ITEM 5 | Two wedges of golden-brown roasted potato with crisp-looking browned edges and a lightly caramelized surface, one wedge about 5 x 3 cm and 2.5 cm thick, the other about 4 x 3 cm, sitting at the lower right of the rice | 85
ITEM 6 | Two small pieces of dark brown glazed nut or date-like item with a glossy, sticky sheen and wrinkled surface, each about 2.5 cm long, placed to the right of the potato | 15
ITEM 7 | Small smear of clear-to-amber pan juice or glaze pooled along the base of the meat and onto the plate, glossy and thin, about 8 x 3 cm | 6
ITEM 8 | Single small grain-like white fleck of rice at the far left edge of the plate, about 0.5 cm | 1
